# [Changelog 3.1.2](https://omega.gg/Sky/changes/3.1.2.html)

### Previous: [Changelog 3.1.1](3.1.1.html)

# [Sky kit](https://omega.gg/Sky)
---

## Overview

This release adds WBashProcess to WBashScript for improved process management, extends
WControllerFile with urlIsSky and urlIsSkz URL helpers and fixes resolvedUrl, refactors
WindowStateChange handling across WAbstractView and WView, and fixes SkyWindow content margins.


## SkCore

- WBashScript: Create WBashProcess.

- WBashScript: Update terminate function.

- WControllerFile: Add urlIsSky function.

- WControllerFile: Create urlIsSkz function.

- WControllerFile: Fix resolvedUrl function.


## SkGui

- WAbstractView: Update WindowStateChange.

- WView: Update WindowStateChange.


## SkyBase

- SkyWindow: Fix content margins.

- Style: Update border_sizeFocus.


## 3rdparty

- Update [qwindowkit](https://github.com/stdware/qwindowkit).
